_help: One entry per speaker in voice.md. Find voices with: node studio/tools/el-voices.mjs search --lang hi --gender male --age old. Add one with: el-voices.mjs add <owner> <voice> --name "Papa (My brand)". Lower stability = more emotion (0.3 to 0.5 for drama); language 'hi' forces Hindi pronunciation, leave it out for Hinglish lines heavy in English.
